prediction_text: Direction: YES — Britain votes to leave the European Union in the referendum of 23 June 2016. The assessment (first published 5 July 2015, firmed up 22 February 2016 when the date was announced and polls showed 'Stay' ahead with many undecided) calls the vote for Leave: the Uranus–Ceres conjunction at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day, read against the UK national charts (1066/1801/1922), is taken as a rupture signature overriding the soft polling lead — the undecided bloc breaks toward exit and Leave carries the day, narrowly. Time coordinate: referendum day, 23 June 2016. Confidence: low-moderate (a contrarian call against the stated polling).
basis:
Card carries no tradition/system field; the card names UK national charts and a referendum-day conjunction, so the system is self-decided from the card's genre as Western mundane astrology (national-chart referendum reading).
systems_used: Western mundane astrology (UK national charts 1066/1801/1922 plus referendum-day transits)
Reasoning: the card's only astrological pointer is Uranus (rupture, sudden break) conjunct Ceres at 23 Aries on the day itself; applied to the national charts this is a severance signature, and the assessment's history on the card (published a year ahead, then firmed up rather than softened when the date was set) indicates a committed Leave call rather than a hedge. Fact-priority: the February polls favouring Stay are respected as a fact but are explicitly the surface layer; the card itself notes the large undecided bloc, which is where the rupture signature is read to land. Object check: the outcome bearer is the referendum result (Leave vs Stay), not the subsequent exit process — only the vote is called. Initial-direction anchor (calibration §9): initial direction = Leave wins, basis = Uranus conjunction rupture signature plus the firmed-up assessment history; direction unchanged, R81-REV1 change gate not applicable. Magnitude (§8): 'narrowly' is the highest resolution claimed — no percentage is derivable from the card.
